partial_workload: two 8xKx8 GEMMs per trip, B selected by previous GEMM output

partial_scopes.0: direct L1 read after producer await; checked
partial_scopes.1: hart1 4-byte DMA and two handoff barriers; checked

replay: exact same copies of six K16/trips3/seed11 ELF files

policy.threshold: Use G at K>=32, otherwise S. Fixed before holdout execution.
policy.dependency_model: Serial calibrated from S one-trip elapsed independently per scope. Increment two ideal tile cycles per extra K/8 (two GEMMs). G moves two one-cycle writes off the path up to the window between first launch and first await return, minus matched lowering delta for extra host instructions if any. Measured target data held out, approximation has no separate DMA-phase model.
policy.count_policy: Use static config count from fixture; ties go to S; never use holdout cycles or traces.
policy.tie_policy: A pick whose cycles equal the minimum is counted correct; W is measured even if identical to S.
